name: SQL Injection via string concatenation
description: User input is concatenated directly into a SQL query string instead of using parameterized queries.
suggested_fix: Use parameterized queries, e.g. cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
example_vulnerable:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '" + user_id + "'"
cursor.execute(query)
example_fixed:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?"
cursor.execute(query, (user_id,))

name: Hardcoded API key / secret
description: A live-looking API key or credential is committed directly in source code.
suggested_fix: Move the value to an environment variable or secrets manager (e.g. os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']) and rotate the exposed key immediately.
source: GitHub Advisory Database — Secret Scanning patterns

name: Command injection via shell=True
description: A subprocess is launched with shell=True while the command string includes request-controlled data, allowing arbitrary command execution.
suggested_fix: Avoid shell=True; pass the command as a list, e.g. subprocess.run(['convert_report.sh', filename, '--format', fmt]).

name: Insecure deserialization (pickle.loads on untrusted input)
description: Untrusted request data is passed directly to pickle.loads, which can execute arbitrary code during deserialization.
suggested_fix: Use a safe serialization format (JSON) for any data crossing a trust boundary; never unpickle request bodies.
source: CVE-2026-31042 (pickle RCE in payment webhook handlers)

name: TLS certificate validation disabled
description: Outbound HTTPS requests disable certificate verification, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks on webhook/callback traffic.
suggested_fix: Remove verify=False. If an internal CA is needed, pass verify='/path/to/ca-bundle.pem' instead.

name: Weak hash (MD5) used for password storage
description: MD5 is used to hash passwords. MD5 is fast and unsalted, making it practical to crack via rainbow tables.
suggested_fix: Use bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2 for password hashing (e.g. bcrypt.hashpw(password, bcrypt.gensalt())).

name: JWT signature verification disabled
description: A JWT is decoded with signature verification turned off, allowing any caller to forge tokens for any user.
suggested_fix: Always verify the signature: jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=['HS256']).

name: Use of eval() on dynamic input
description: eval() executes a string as Python code. If any part of that string is influenced by user input, it allows arbitrary code execution.
suggested_fix: Replace eval() with a safe expression parser (e.g. ast.literal_eval for literals, or a allow-listed filter DSL).

name: Unsafe YAML load
description: yaml.load() without SafeLoader can instantiate arbitrary Python objects from the YAML document, leading to code execution on malicious config files.
suggested_fix: Use yaml.safe_load(f.read()) or yaml.load(f.read(), Loader=yaml.SafeLoader).

name: Shell command built from unsanitized path
description: A shell command string is built by concatenating a variable, allowing path/argument injection if that variable is attacker-influenced.
suggested_fix: Use shutil.rmtree(path) instead of os.system, after validating the path is within an expected directory.
source: CWE Top 25 Most Dangerous Software Weaknesses 2026

name: Debug mode enabled in production entrypoint
description: Flask's debug mode exposes an interactive debugger and stack traces with source code on unhandled exceptions, and can allow remote code execution via the debugger PIN.
suggested_fix: Set debug=False in production and run behind a WSGI server (gunicorn/uwsgi) with FLASK_ENV=production.

name: Pinned dependency with known CVE (requests < 2.20.0)
description: requests versions before 2.20.0 leak the Proxy-Authorization header on cross-origin redirects (CVE-2018-18074), and this pinned version predates numerous later fixes.
suggested_fix: Upgrade to requests>=2.32.0 in requirements.txt.

name: Pinned dependency with known CVE (pyyaml < 5.4)
description: pyyaml versions before 5.4 are vulnerable to arbitrary code execution via yaml.load (CVE-2020-14343).
suggested_fix: Upgrade to pyyaml>=6.0.1 in requirements.txt.

name: Pinned dependency with known CVE (pyjwt < 2.4.0)
description: pyjwt versions before 2.4.0 are vulnerable to algorithm confusion attacks allowing JWT signature bypass (CVE-2022-29217).
suggested_fix: Upgrade to pyjwt>=2.8.0 in requirements.txt.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery via unvalidated webhook URL
description: A URL taken directly from the request body is fetched server-side with no allow-list, letting an attacker probe internal services (SSRF).
suggested_fix: Validate the host against an allow-list of known callback domains before fetching, and block requests to private IP ranges.
source: FTC Business Blog — SSRF in webhook integrations, 2026-10
example_fixed:
url = request.json["callback_url"]
if not is_allowed_host(url):
    abort(400)
resp = requests.get(url)

name: Missing rate limiting on authentication endpoint
description: The login endpoint has no rate limiting, making it vulnerable to credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks reported in this week's carrier fraud bulletin.
suggested_fix: Add a rate limiter (e.g. Flask-Limiter) capping login attempts per IP/account, and lock the account after repeated failures.

name: Improper Authentication (insecure secret comparison) - precedent: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
suggested_fix: Use hmac.compare_digest() instead of == to compare secrets, tokens or signatures  -  a plain == leaks timing information an attacker can use to guess the value byte by byte.
source: CISA KEV Catalog  -  CVE-2024-27834 (Apple Multiple Products), added 2026-11-04

name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function - precedent: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
description: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit authentication/authorization check to this endpoint. This class of bug depends on business logic our static scanner can't infer automatically  -  flagged for manual review.
source: CISA KEV Catalog  -  CVE-2026-111357 (Ivanti Connect Secure), added 2026-10-30

name: Path Traversal - precedent: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
description: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.
suggested_fix: Resolve the requested path against a fixed base directory with os.path.realpath() and reject any path that escapes it, or map requests to an allow-list of known file IDs instead of raw paths.
source: CISA KEV Catalog  -  CVE-2025-61624 (Fortinet Multiple Products), added 2026-10-16

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) - precedent: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
description: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.
suggested_fix: Never build HTML by string-concatenating user input. Use render_template with Jinja autoescaping, or escape manually with markupsafe.escape().
source: CISA KEV Catalog  -  CVE-2026-42897 (Microsoft Microsoft), added 2026-05-15

name: Open Redirect - precedent: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
description: Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle Application Server Single Sign-On component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect integrity via Unknown vectors
suggested_fix: Validate the redirect target against an allow-list of known internal paths before calling redirect(), or only allow relative paths.
source: CISA KEV Catalog  -  CVE-2012-0518 (Oracle Fusion Middleware), added 2022-03-28
